title: Create a trimmed weights vector — trim_weights_y2
code: trim_weights_y2(   weights_schema,   limit_method = c("standard deviations", "percentile", "decimal"),   upper_limit = 3,   lower_limit = -3,   strict = TRUE )

title: Create a trimmed weights vector — trim_weights_y2
text: weights_schema complex, raked, survey.design object (can created using rake_y2() function). limit_method (default = 'standard deviations') type limits used upper_limit/lower_limit arguments. Currently accepts 'standard deviations', 'percentile', 'decimal'. upper_limit (default = 3) Set upper trim limit weights (default 3 SDs trim .3% weights). limit_method set 'percentile', limit upper percentile weight trimmed. limit_method set 'decimal', limit upper numerical limit weight. lower_limit (default = -3) Set lower trim limit weights (default 3 SDs trim .3% weights). limit_method set 'percentile', limit lower percentile weight trimmed. limit_method set 'decimal', limit lower numerical limit weight. strict (default = TRUE) reapportionment ‘trimmings’ weights may sometimes push weights limits. strict = TRUE function repeats trimming iteratively prevent .
